details: Major central banks, including the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, Bank of Japan, and Bank of England, are scheduled to announce interest rate decisions. Sticky inflation and geopolitical tensions could lead to a 'higher for longer' rate environment, which traditionally weights on risk assets like cryptocurrencies. Some experts suggest inflation could increase in 2026.
title: Upcoming Central Bank Decisions & Sticky Inflation Concerns

details: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have experienced significant net inflows, reflecting strong institutional demand. This interest supports Bitcoin's price near $78,000, and analysts predict ETFs could purchase over 100% of newly mined Bitcoin in 2026, creating a structural demand floor.
title: Robust Bitcoin ETF Inflows Signal Strong Institutional Demand

details: Central banks and the Bank for International Settlements are increasingly viewing stablecoins as potential systemic risks to monetary policy and traditional banking. Concerns include potential runs, dollarization in developing economies, and impacts on bank deposits, leading to calls for global regulatory cooperation.
title: Central Banks Eye Stablecoins as Potential Systemic Risk
